INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.

2. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Writing for information – Paragraphs.

   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Only memorise without using the language

11. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)

----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Presentation skills – Debate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
